    Networkpaser - Class in paser

    Networkpaser() - Constructor for class paser.Networkpaser
     
    Networkpaser.Edge - Class in paser
    Represents a road edge connecting two junctions, containing one or more lanes.
    Networkpaser.Junction - Class in paser
    Represents a junction (intersection) in the road network with position, type, and shape information.
    Networkpaser.Lane - Class in paser
    Represents a traffic lane within an edge, including geometric shape, speed limit, and physical dimensions.
    Networkpaser.MidLine - Class in paser
    Represents a calculated midline between two opposite directional edges, used for rendering center lane markings.
    Networkpaser.NetworkModel - Class in paser
    Container class holding the complete parsed network data including all edges, junctions, midlines, and bounding box coordinates for the entire network.
